verdict.rationale: The only litigation signal is the IP practice page's title, "Patent Litigation | Patent Counseling & Prosecution." The quoted content covers patent prosecution and counseling, trademark portfolio management, and trade-secret protection programs, not contested disputes. Missing for 10: any description of patent, trademark or trade-secret litigation matters, named courts or venues (e.g., district courts, PTAB, ITC, TTAB), case outcomes or verdicts, and independent corroboration of an IP litigation track record.
